seed_selection: ADR 0006 fresh acceptance: 20 seeds drawn from the inclusive range [1000000, 2147483647], excluding every used seed (ledger, catalog, committed suites, and committed fresh-draw reports). Historical seeds are tracked by unified-d5-regression-v4, not by this suite.
step_cap_rationale: 3000 steps, fixed by the note 0035 held-out probes; no completion in note 0035 or in the 120 current-policy fresh development episodes of note 0046 needed more. min_success_rate 0.65 applies the frozen note 0035 rule to those 120 episodes (99/120 = 0.825; 0.825 - 0.15 rounded down to 0.05).
